g.text: How strongly does omission increase abstention?

text.style: font-size: 17px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526578

g.text: Change in E rate = E rate with omission − E rate on clean passages

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526578

g.text: Larger increases mean more abstention in response to omission after accounting for the clean-passage baseline.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526578

g.text: This measures responsiveness, not the correctness of E choices. Llama 3.2 3B is excluded because no omission runs are available.

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526578

g.text: Shared tested doses are shown. Compare datasets within each model; omission-window extraction differs between model campaigns.
